requirements.requirement: TRS minutes for Fund cost recovery derive from completed interstate or internet-based TRS calls after call setup through the last message call unit, with integrated VRS governed by paragraph (e).
A compensation request is not payable until the administrator in consultation with the Commission, or the Commission, determines that the provider met its burden to establish compensability.
An Internet-based TRS provider must be Commission-certified under 64.606 to be eligible for Fund payment.

Each compensation request carries a certification by a CEO, CFO, or other senior executive with first-hand knowledge covering accuracy/completeness, compliance with section 225 and Commission rules/orders, and absence of impermissible call-generation incentives.
Failure to submit to a requested audit or provide verification documentation triggers automatic payment suspension until cured.

Withheld minutes remain unresolved until the provider supplies adequate justification and the administrator/Commission determines compensability; insufficient or absent response may lead to permanent denial.
A VRS provider may not offer incentives to encourage registration or use; noncompliance makes the service ineligible for Fund compensation.

A provider may not seek Fund payment for minutes it knows or has reason to know result from false/unverified claims, unauthorized use, induced calls, or use by persons not needing the service; known practices must be reported as soon as practicable.
Remote-training-session or comparable calls are non-compensable when the submitting provider or related party is involved in arranging, sponsoring, hosting, conducting, or promoting the activity.

VRS calls originating from an international IP address are non-compensable unless a U.S. resident pre-registered before travel for specified periods/regions and identity and location can be accurately verified.
Each integrated-VRS video conference is treated as one call for compensation unless specifically authorized otherwise.
Integrated-VRS compensable time begins when the CA enters the conference only if the requesting registered VRS user is identified within five minutes; otherwise the call is non-compensable.

Integrated-VRS compensable time ends at the earliest listed termination event, including CA departure, all signing/non-signing participants leaving, or the requesting user leaving followed by five minutes without another registered request.
